name: Gap rule (10:00, straight intraday path) only when the 10-session daily path is NOT straight (e10 < 0.429) — confirmation 2019–24
why: The gap-side day direction continues best when the market has not already trended for two weeks: a fresh overnight repositioning after a choppy fortnight has room to run. Pre-registered 2026-10-18 (research/preregistered/2026-10-18_daily_path_direction.md) — confirmation of the 2010-18 pick.

scan.when: t == 600 && ((!rollwin && abs(gap) >= 0.1)*sign(gap)) != 0 && (abs(px-open)/max(hod-lod, 1)) >= 0.55 && sign(px-open) == ((!rollwin && abs(gap) >= 0.1)*sign(gap)) && ((c == 1)*(e10 >= 0.429 && sign(r10) == ((!rollwin && abs(gap) >= 0.1)*sign(gap))) + (c == 2)*(e10 >= 0.429 && sign(r10) == -((!rollwin && abs(gap) >= 0.1)*sign(gap))) + (c == 3)*(e10 < 0.429)) > 0
